messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tell your doctor about all your other medicines.
Some may interact with pantoprazole, especially:
digoxin;
methotrexate; or
a diuretic or "water pill."
This list is not complete.
Other drugs may affect pantoprazole.
These other drugs include prescription and over-the-counter medicines.
These other drugs also include vitamins and herbal products.
Not all possible drug interactions are listed here.
Triplet: ["Pantoprazole", "may interact with", "prescription medicines"]

The relation 'may interact with' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug could potentially have an interaction with the category of substances or medications specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may be prescribed with': The subject drug may be prescribed in combination with the medication specified by the object entity.
B. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
C. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'related to': The subject drug is associated with the medical condition or disease specified by the object entity.
E. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
